lines.en: label mollydorm25:
Molly and I escape back into the warmth of the dorm just as the night decides to get all fucking annoying and start showing off how fast it can make the wind go.
lines.zh: Molly 和我逃回宿舍的温暖里，而夜色偏偏在这时候决定变得他妈的讨人厌，开始炫耀它能把风刮得多快。

lines.en: She appears a little confused the moment I start following her upstairs, but makes no effort to actually stop me.
lines.zh: 我跟着她上楼的时候，她看起来有点困惑，却完全没打算真的拦我。

lines.en: I imagine there’s a chance she’s just worried that she’ll have to think up some sort of {i}actual{/i} quest reward or whatever it was I was promised-
lines.zh: 我想，有可能她只是担心自己得现想出某种{i}真正{/i}的任务奖励，或者当初答应我的那玩意儿——

lines.en: But I imagine there is an even {i}better{/i} chance that she’s just confused about where things will go from here as a whole.
lines.zh: 但我觉得{i}更大{/i}的可能是，她只是搞不清楚从这儿开始事情整体会往哪儿走。

lines.en: So am I, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我也不知道。

lines.en: I mean, surely I wouldn’t be seizing this opportunity to make some sort of move on a cute girl fighting off both the sting of rejection and sleep deprivation, would I?
lines.zh: 我是说，我总不至于趁这个机会，对一个正同时抵御拒绝的刺痛和睡眠不足的可爱女生下手吧？

lines.en: I remain silent in hopes that asking myself this rhetorical question will somehow push me in either direction.
lines.zh: 我保持沉默，指望这个反问句能以某种方式把我推向某个方向。

lines.en: Unfortunately-
lines.zh: 不幸的是——

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging1
I somehow wind up inside of her room.
lines.zh: 我不知怎么就进到她房间里了。

lines.en: Now, the reason I use the word {i}un{/i}fortunately isn’t because I’m worried about how forcing a girl into an uncomfortable position will feel-
lines.zh: 现在我用「{i}不{/i}幸」这个词，不是因为我担心把一个女生逼到尴尬的境地会是什么感觉——

lines.en: But it’s because I feel slightly bad that Molly can’t really do anything to change that.
lines.zh: 而是因为 Molly 对这件事其实无能为力，这让我有点过意不去。

lines.en: Nor do I know if she {i}would{/i} change that, given the opportunity.
lines.zh: 我也不知道，就算有机会，她{i}会不会{/i}想去改变。

lines.en: All I know is that she said she was worried that being back here would cause her to start thinking.
lines.zh: 我只知道她说过，她担心回到这儿会让自己开始胡思乱想。

lines.en: Sometimes, however, I think it’s better to act without any thought put into things at all.
lines.zh: 不过有时候我觉得，做事不带任何思考反而更好。

lines.en: Hence, bedroom.
lines.zh: 所以，卧室。

lines.en: : Sir, if this is about your quest reward, I’m afraid I don’t have one on hand right now.
lines.zh: : 老师，如果这是为了您的任务奖励，恐怕我眼下手上没有。

lines.en: : Eh. I don’t need a reward.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我不需要奖励。

lines.en: : I’m just bored.
lines.zh: : 我只是无聊。

lines.en: : Darkness has already consumed the land, and yet you beg for more of Molly MacCormack?
lines.zh: : 黑暗已经吞噬了这片土地，而您却还贪求更多 Molly MacCormack 的陪伴？

lines.en: : What would Arborea say?
lines.zh: : Arborea 会怎么说？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, who?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，谁？

lines.en: : Apologies, Sir. I meant Ami.
lines.zh: : 失礼了，老师。我是说 Ami。

lines.en: : Does she not spend each night in silence, awaiting both your presence and a single genre tag that forces people to download a video game without even reading the description first?
lines.zh: : 她难道不是每晚都在寂静中等着您，同时也等着一个能让人们连简介都不看就下载一款电子游戏的单一题材标签吗？

lines.en: : Besides, I’m sure Ami is fine. Chances are she’s already asleep.
lines.zh: : 再说了，我肯定 Ami 没事。她多半已经睡了。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging2
: Ahh, sleep...
lines.zh: : 啊，睡眠……

lines.en: : I remember those days well. T’was back when I was just a lass.
lines.zh: : 那些日子我记得很清楚。那还是我不过是个小姑娘的时候。

lines.en: : Long before I’d given up on ever experiencing the taste of sweet slumber ever again.
lines.zh: : 远在我放弃再次尝到甜美梦乡的滋味之前。

lines.en: : Cool. More time to hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 挺好。那就有更多时间陪我了。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging3
: Sir, you have been suspiciously nice to me all night. It’s beginning to feel like you may have accidentally activated my route instead of someone else’s.
lines.zh: : 老师，您今晚对我是不是好得有点可疑。我开始觉得您可能不小心触发了我的线，而不是别人的。

lines.en: : I’m just doing what I always do. It’s up to you whether or not this is about to become {i}your{/i} route.
lines.zh: : 我只是在做我一直都在做的事。这到底会不会变成{i}你的{/i}线，取决于你。

lines.en: : It’s never up to the heroine, Sir. That’s just an illusion meant to trick readers into believing they’ve done more than click buttons and set a few invisible flags to “True.”
lines.zh: : 这从来不由女主角决定，老师。那只是一种幻觉，用来骗读者相信他们做的远不止点点按钮、把几个看不见的旗标设成「True」。

lines.en: : Well, whatever it is, I’d still like to kill a little time before heading back home.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管怎样，我还是想在回家之前消磨点时间。

lines.en: : Unless you’re planning on letting me crash here, that is.
lines.zh: : 除非你打算让我在这儿过夜。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging4
: Well...I suppose I wouldn’t have much of an issue for that. Party members sleep together and manage to avoid getting physical all the time.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想我对那个倒没什么意见。队友们睡在一起，却全程不越界，这种事多了去了。

lines.en: : I mean...we don’t have to {i}avoid-{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们也不必{i}不越{/i}——

lines.en: : The main issue is that the Kendo Princess normally comes home around this time as well, and I can’t imagine she would feel very comfortable with this...sudden development.
lines.zh: : 主要问题在于，剑道公主平时也差不多这个点回来，我实在想象不出她对这种……突发状况会感到多自在。

lines.en: : Then I’ll just stay until Tsuneyo is back.
lines.zh: : 那我就待到 Tsuneyo 回来为止。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging5
: That seems like a respectable decision.
lines.zh: : 这倒是个体面的决定。

lines.en: : The issue now is that I would like to switch transmogrifications, which I can not do with you standing there gawking at me.
lines.zh: : 现在的问题是，我想切换一下变形形态，可您站在那儿盯着我看，我没法换。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you just said to me.
lines.zh: : 我完全没听懂你刚才说了什么。

lines.en: : Pajamas, Sir. I would like to get changed.
lines.zh: : 睡衣，老师。我想换衣服。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. Go right ahead.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。你换吧。

lines.en: : {i}Without you gawking at me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}在您不盯着我看的情况下。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh.
: Yeah, I can’t help that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这个我可做不到。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging6
: But...you have already seen me without my armor on once before.
lines.zh: : 可是……您以前已经看过我一次不穿盔甲的样子了。

lines.en: : Yeah, which is why I don’t think it’s a big deal.
lines.zh: : 对，所以我才觉得这没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : Just keep talking. It’s only weird if you decide to make it weird.
lines.zh: : 你继续说话就行。只有你自己把它弄得很怪，它才会很怪。

lines.en: : It appears that you have already decided to make it weird. Cease holding your actions and use them to look away.
lines.zh: : 看来您已经决定把它弄得很怪了。别再憋着您的动作了，用它们转过头去。

lines.en: : Hey, you still owe me a quest reward. This would be a good time for that, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你还欠我一个任务奖励呢。现在给正合适吧？

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging7
: Ahh...lookin’ to barter, are ye?
lines.zh: : 啊……您这是在讨价还价吗？

lines.en: : How about this then, Sir?
lines.zh: : 那这样如何，老师？

lines.en: : The Halloween party is just a short while away. What if I told you I could give you a behind the scenes glimpse at the costumes of various girls in our class?
lines.zh: : 万圣节派对就在不久之后。要是我说我能让您提前瞄一眼我们班上几个女生的 costume 呢？

lines.en: : Go on.
lines.zh: : 继续说。

lines.en: : So long as you manage to keep me out of your line of sight for the duration of my transmogrification, I’ll show you.
lines.zh: : 只要您在我变形期间能让自己别往我这边看，我就给您看。

lines.en: : I don’t know, Molly. Real life still sounds a little better than a few pictures.
lines.zh: : 我可不知道，Molly。真人还是比几张照片听起来好一点。

lines.en: : It is six girls, Sir.
lines.zh: : 是六个女生，老师。

lines.en: : Six? Damn it. That’s so many.
lines.zh: : 六个？该死。这也太多了。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging8
: The costumes are rather form fitting as well. If you look closely enough, you can see {i}everything{/i}, Sir.
lines.zh: : 而且那些 costume 相当贴身。您要是看得够仔细，{i}什么{/i}都能看见，老师。

lines.en: : Everything?
lines.zh: : 什么都能？

lines.en: : Right down to the last mana circuit.
lines.zh: : 连最后一条法力回路都看得清。

lines.en: : Tch.
I click my tongue like some sort of anime protagonist and accept that this proposition will be the end of me.
lines.zh: 我像某个动画主角那样咂了下舌，认命地接受这个提议会是我的末日。

lines.en: Well, the end of my chances of seeing Molly naked right now.
lines.zh: 好吧，是我现在想看 Molly 裸体的机会的末日。

lines.en: I’m sure I’ll be able to see the real thing up close sooner or later.
lines.zh: 我敢说迟早还是能近距离看到真货的。

lines.en: Just...it probably won’t be soon {i}enough.{/i}
lines.zh: 只是……大概不会有{i}多快{/i}。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay, fine.
lines.zh: : 行吧，好吧。

lines.en: : But I reserve the right to trade away the picture and turn around at any moment.
lines.zh: : 但我保留随时放弃这张照片、转身过去看你的权利。

lines.en: : What kind of ass backwards deal is that, Sir? Roll for persuasion.
lines.zh: : 老师，这算什么狗屁倒灶的交易啊？投个说服检定吧。

lines.en: : Roll for what?
lines.zh: : 投什么？

lines.en: : Geh. Fine, I’ll roll for ya and-
lines.zh: : 呃。行吧，我替您投，然后——

lines.en: : Brigid’s bosom, it’s a natural twenty.
lines.zh: : Brigid 的胸怀啊，是个天然二十。

lines.en: : Is that good or bad?
lines.zh: : 这是好还是坏？

lines.en: : Good for you, bad for me. You win your wonky barter clause, Sir. But please do try to not invoke it.
lines.zh: : 对您是好事，对我是坏事。老师，您赢了您那个荒唐的讨价还价条款。不过请尽量别援引它。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging9
: Do you just keep dice on you at all times or something?
lines.zh: : 你该不会随时都随身带着骰子吧？

lines.en: : Of course, Sir. You never know when you’re going to need a D20. And dice apps just can’t compete with the feeling of a nice, solid one in your hands.
lines.zh: : 那当然，老师。你永远不知道什么时候会需要一个 D20。而骰子 app 根本比不上一颗又漂亮又结实的骰子握在手里的感觉。

lines.en: : I’ve got a nice solid one right here.
lines.zh: : 我这儿就有一颗又漂亮又结实的。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging10

lines.zh: : 一颗 D20？

lines.en: : A penis.
lines.zh: : 一根阴茎。

lines.en: : It was an erection joke.
lines.zh: : 这是个勃起笑话。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging11
: O...Oh! Yes! I knew that.
lines.zh: : 哦……哦！对！我懂的。

lines.en: : Nothing beats a good ole...dirty joke. That’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 没什么能比得上老派的……荤笑话。这是肯定的。

lines.en: : Why are you the one making things weird after finally convincing me not to?
lines.zh: : 你好不容易说服我别把事情弄得很怪，怎么现在弄得很怪的人反而是你？

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging12
: Hah...Who knows, Sir?
lines.zh: : 哈……谁知道呢，老师？

lines.en: : You should be happy I haven’t pounced on you and demanded that we kiss, yet.
lines.zh: : 您该庆幸我还没扑到您身上，要求我们接吻。

lines.en: : Should I? Because that sounds a lot like a thing that I would enjoy.
lines.zh: : 该庆幸吗？因为那听起来很像是我会享受的事。

lines.en: : Doubtful, Sir. You find me annoying and have already confirmed with ye’ own eyes what I watch when I’m...indulging myself.
lines.zh: : 不见得吧，老师。您觉得我烦人，而且您已经亲眼确认过我……放纵自己的时候都看些什么。

lines.en: : Why would knowing you [masturbate] to pictures of Rin make me not want you?
lines.zh: : 知道你 [masturbate] 的时候看 Rin 的照片，为什么会让我不想要你？

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging13
: Some would equate even minor actions like that to NTR, Sir.
lines.zh: : 有些人连这种小事都会等同于 NTR，老师。

lines.en: : Some men just have so little confidence that they get angry if even cartoons don’t pay sufficient attention to them.
lines.zh: : 有些男人就是自信少到连卡通人物不够关注他们都会生气。

lines.en: : That’s just sad.
lines.zh: : 那可真可悲。

lines.en: : Thankfully, we are both real people and those sorts of things don’t apply to us.
lines.zh: : 幸好我们俩都是真人，那些东西跟我们不相干。

lines.en: : I thank you for the privilege to [masturbate] to my friends without the fear of losing you, Sir.
lines.zh: : 那么感谢老师恩准我可以 [masturbate] 想着我的朋友，还不用担心失去您。

lines.en: : You’re welcome, Molly.
lines.zh: : 不客气，Molly。

lines.en: : I’d appreciate to be included in those fantasies from time to time as well, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我也希望偶尔能被写进那些幻想里。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging14
: ‘Tis hard when you’re nothing more than a ghost on the Internet, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，您不过只是互联网上的一个幽灵，这可难办啊。

lines.en: : Why should I submit to fantasy when there are so many accessible swimsuit pictures of people I’m attracted to?
lines.zh: : 既然我喜欢的那些人有那么多随手可得的泳装照片，我何必屈从于幻想呢？

lines.en: : I thought fantasizing about stuff was kind of your thing?
lines.zh: : 我还以为幻想这种事算是你的专长？

lines.en: : Not all of the time, Sir.
lines.zh: : 不全是，老师。

lines.en: : Just most of it.
lines.zh: : 只是大部分时候是。

lines.en: : So, what I’m hearing is that the key reason you [masturbate] to Rin instead of me is because she has a social media profile.
lines.zh: : 那么我听到的意思是，你 [masturbate] 的时候选 Rin 不选我，关键原因是她有社交账号。

lines.en: : Aye, Sir. The profile helps.
lines.zh: : 是的，老师。账号确实有帮助。

lines.en: : Molly, this is the single best argument anyone has given me for starting one of those things yet.
lines.zh: : Molly，这是到目前为止别人给我安利开社交账号的最佳理由了。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging15
: I’m glad to have been of service, Sir!
lines.zh: : 能为您效劳，我荣幸之至，老师！

lines.en: : Now, come! Feast your eyes upon tonight’s quest reward in the form of six girls in costumes you will likely not recognize!
lines.zh: : 那么来吧！好好饱览今晚的任务奖励——六个穿着您多半认不出来的 costume 的女生！

lines.en: scene black
Molly removes her cell phone from a pile of clothes she left near the door and begins to make her way over to the bed, swiping through various images until she finds the one she needs.
lines.zh: Molly 从她在门边留下的一堆衣服里掏出手机，一边往床边走，一边划过一张张图片，直到找到她要的那张。

lines.en: I take a seat beside her and she pulls her knees closer to her chest before tilting her screen up and showing me my apparent reward.
lines.zh: 我在她旁边坐下，她把膝盖往胸口收了收，然后把屏幕向上倾斜，给我看我所谓的奖励。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging16
: So, I’m sure you have no idea what any of this is, nor do I imagine you want me to educate you, but here you go.
lines.zh: : 那么，我猜您完全不知道这是什么，也不觉得您需要我来科普，不过您请看。

lines.en: : The members of the manga club...and Ayane have decided to do a group cosplay for Halloween this year.
lines.zh: : 漫画社的成员们……还有 Ayane 决定今年万圣节搞一次团体 cosplay。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging17
: Why doesn’t Ayane just join the club as well if she’s going to keep doing literally everything with you guys anyway?
lines.zh: : 既然 Ayane 反正什么都要跟你们一起做，她干脆加入社团不就好了？

lines.en: : Something about wanting to save more time for when you two elope, I believe.
lines.zh: : 好像是说要给您俩私奔多留点时间吧，我记得。

lines.en: : Is that really all you have to say, though? I was expecting more of an excited reaction out of you, Sir.
lines.zh: : 不过您就只能说这些吗，老师？我还以为您反应会更激动一点呢。

lines.en: : Especially with all of our thighs being out there in the open.
lines.zh: : 尤其是在我们所有人的大腿都露在外面的情况下。

lines.en: : Oh, don’t get me wrong, I think you all look great.
lines.zh: : 哦，别误会，我觉得你们都很好看。

lines.en: : But, if anything, I’m just more excited to see you all in person now.
lines.zh: : 但如果说有什么的话，我现在更想亲眼看到你们。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging18
: You will not have to wait much longer, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，您不用等太久了。

lines.en: : I intend to make this Halloween one that I will remember for the rest of eternity! Especially after losing most of my memories of the last one!
lines.zh: : 我打算让这个万圣节成为我永生难忘的回忆！尤其是在我几乎丢光了上一个万圣节的记忆之后！

lines.en: : You were...extremely drunk.
lines.zh: : 你那时候……醉得厉害。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging19
: You probably should have called an ambulance. I could have died.
lines.zh: : 您大概该叫辆救护车的。我差点就没命了。

lines.en: if harukalust10 == True:
: Sorry. I had...things to do.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我当时有……事要办。

lines.en: : What sort of thing would be more important than saving a student’s life?
lines.zh: : 有什么事能比救一个学生的命更重要？

lines.en: : A threesome with two cat girls.
lines.zh: : 和两个猫娘的三人行。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well...yes. I understand completely, if that was the case.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。如果是那样的话，我完全理解。

lines.en: else:
: Sorry. I had...
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我当时有……

lines.en: scene harukalusttenskip3
scene mollydormchanging19
: I had to fix some pipes...
lines.zh: : 我得去修几根管子……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : Anyway, what else do you have for me?
lines.zh: : 总之，你还有别的给我看吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 您说什么？

lines.en: : That can’t be the only picture, can it?
lines.zh: : 不可能只有这一张吧？

lines.en: : There are some on the other girls’ Instagrams, but the only extra ones I had were of Rin from when I tailored hers...and I deleted all of those.
lines.zh: : 其他女生的 Instagram 上还有一些，不过我手里多出来的只有 Rin 的——那是我帮她改衣服的时候拍的……而那些我全删了。

lines.en: : Really? Not going to keep them around to-
lines.zh: : 真的？不留着用来——

lines.en: : Please don’t, Sir. It still hurts, even if I’m not acting torn up about it.
lines.zh: : 老师，别说了。就算我表现得没那么崩溃，那件事还是让我难受。

lines.en: : That’s weird. Because we were talking about it a few minutes ago and you seemed totally fine then.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。因为我们几分钟前还在聊这个，那时候你看起来完全没事啊。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging20
: I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : But seeing her again made it hard.
lines.zh: : 可又见到她，就变得很难了。

lines.en: : I’m only good at running away from my problems when they’re not trying to catch up, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 我想，只有在问题没有追上来的时候，我才擅长逃避它们。

lines.en: : My movement speed just isn’t fast enough.
lines.zh: : 我的移动速度就是不够快。

lines.en: : Well, I’m not going to keep pestering you about it. I’ve done enough of that today and I’m starting to think I might be doing to {i}you{/i} what you always do to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不会再拿这事烦{i}你{/i}了。今天我已经烦得够多了，我开始觉得我可能正在对你做你一直对我做的事。

lines.en: : I don’t mind. It’s nice having friends again.
lines.zh: : 我不介意。重新有朋友的感觉挺好的。

lines.en: : Okay, I guess I’ll pester you one last time in informing you that you {i}do{/i} still have friends.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我就最后再烦你一次，告诉你你{i}确实{/i}还有朋友。

lines.en: : Getting into a fight over liking someone isn’t enough to destroy something like that. And, if it is, it was probably a shitty friendship to begin with.
lines.zh: : 为了喜欢谁而吵一架，还不至于毁掉那样的东西。而如果真能毁掉，那大概从一开始就是段糟糕的友情。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging21
: Sir, you are forgetting how things ended. It may not sound as bad for someone who wasn’t there, but it was extremely awkward for even my standards.
lines.zh: : 老师，您忘了事情是怎么收场的。对没在场的人来说也许听着没那么糟，但就算以我的标准来看，那也尴尬得要命。

lines.en: : And need I remind you that I have very high standards for what is and isn’t awkward?
lines.zh: : 还需要我提醒您吗，对于什么算尴尬、什么不算，我的标准可是很高的。

lines.en: : No reminder is necessary. You’re probably the most socially awkward person I know apart from Tsuneyo or Kaori or...Yasu-
lines.zh: : 不用提醒。除了 Tsuneyo、Kaori 或者……Yasu——你大概是我认识的人里最不会社交的了。

lines.en: : Why are so many of you awkward?
lines.zh: : 你们怎么有这么多人都这么别扭啊？

lines.en: : The point, Sir. You are losing it.
lines.zh: : 重点，老师。您跑题了。

lines.en: : Right, sorry.
lines.zh: : 对，抱歉。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is that apart from the various...{i}special{/i} cases, the only other person I know who is almost as awkward as you is Rin.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是，除了那些……{i}特殊{/i}情况，我认识的人里唯一一个跟你差不多别扭的，就是 Rin。

lines.en: : Which means that she’s more likely to just get over this than anyone else.
lines.zh: : 这意味着她比任何人都更有可能就这么翻篇。

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging22
: That “maybe” causes me a great deal of worry, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，这个「也许」让我非常不安。

lines.en: : Well, if you’re {i}that{/i} worried...just go talk to her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你要是{i}这么{/i}担心……就去跟她谈谈。

lines.en: : I don’t know...the last time I took someone’s advice about this, I was either duped or...I greatly misunderstood that person.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……上一次我听了别人在这方面的建议，结果要么是被耍了，要么就是……我大大地误解了那个人。

lines.en: : The great downfall occurred just shortly after that, when I had already chosen the path I was going to walk.
lines.zh: : 那场大崩塌就发生在那之后不久，而那时我已经选好了自己要走的路。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging23
: But...as the gears screeched to a halt and all of the cogs in this machine called “life”  stopped spinning, I knew something needed to be done.
lines.zh: : 可是……当齿轮吱呀一声停住，这台叫「人生」的机器里所有嵌齿都不再转动时，我知道必须做点什么了。

lines.en: : If only I had known that “something” was the opposite of what the voice inside of my head commanded of me.
lines.zh: : 要是我早点知道，那件「什么事」恰恰跟我脑子里那个声音命令我做的相反就好了。

lines.en: : So, are you going to talk to her or not?
lines.zh: : 所以，你到底要不要去跟她谈？

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging24
: What, like...right now?
lines.zh: : 什么，就……现在？

lines.en: : Sure. Rin stays up late, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 对啊。Rin 不是睡得很晚吗？

lines.en: : And if there’s anything I’ve learned about serious situations in the dorms, it’s that a person’s roommate is almost always conveniently missing exactly when they need to be.
lines.zh: : 而且说到宿舍里的严肃场合，我学到的一点是：一个人的室友几乎总会在她们最需要她不在的时候，恰好不在。

lines.en: : You know, Sir...Now that you mention it, I do remember Futaba mentioning something about going to the bookstore with Nodoka tonight.
lines.zh: : 老师，您这么一说……我确实记得 Futaba 提过今晚要和 Nodoka 去书店。

lines.en: : See what I mean? Now is as good a time as any.
lines.zh: : 明白我意思了吧？现在就是最好的时机。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging25
: I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : Rin said she wanted to take a break from speaking for a while.
lines.zh: : Rin 说过她想安静一阵子，不想说话。

lines.en: : And...and what if Otoha is there?
lines.zh: : 而且……而且万一 Otoha 在那儿呢？

lines.en: : At this hour? Her mother would never allow that.
lines.zh: : 这个点？她妈妈不可能允许的。

lines.en: Molly takes a moment to think about what her next move is going to be.
lines.zh: Molly 花了一点时间思考下一步该怎么走。

lines.en: I’m sure it's hard deliberation considering her only options are “keep indefinitely being sad” or “risk becoming more sad in order to be less sad right now,” but...those are kind of the only options we ever have.
lines.zh: 我敢说这番斟酌很艰难，因为她仅有的选项不过是「继续无限期地难过下去」和「为了现在少难过一点，冒着变得更难过的风险」，不过……我们从来也就只有这些选项。

lines.en: And even if time does have a way of mysteriously healing things, it doesn’t mean it’s exciting to just sit back and let that happen.
lines.zh: 而就算时间确实有种神秘的治愈能力，也不代表袖手旁观等着它发生是什么让人兴奋的事。

lines.en: The most ideal scenario right now would be for Molly and Rin to {i}both{/i} be happy.
lines.zh: 眼下最理想的局面，是 Molly 和 Rin {i}都{/i}开心。

lines.en: And if I have to put someone else’s well-being at stake in order to risk that, so be it.
lines.zh: 而如果为了赌这一把，我得把别人的安危押上去，那就押吧。

lines.en: : Will you...come with me?
lines.zh: : 您……愿意陪我一起去吗？

lines.en: : Me? Why?
lines.zh: : 我？为什么？

lines.en: : Moral support, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 精神上的支持吧，我想。

lines.en: : Our party hasn’t disbanded yet, so...just think of it as another side quest.
lines.zh: : 我们的队伍还没解散呢，所以……就当是又一个支线任务吧。

lines.en: : Fine. But the reward for this better be more than just a picture of my students wearing clothes, skin tight or not.
lines.zh: : 好。不过这次的奖励最好不止一张我学生们穿着衣服的照片，紧身也好不紧身也好。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging26
: Understood, Sir. And thank you.
lines.zh: : 明白了，老师。还有谢谢您。

lines.en: : But...I still don’t know what I should say.
lines.zh: : 可是……我还是不知道该说什么。

lines.en: : When in doubt, just be honest.
lines.zh: : 拿不准的时候，就实话实说。

lines.en: : That’s what I always do and it only backfires like...less than half of the time.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是这么做的，而它适得其反的概率也就……不到一半吧。

lines.en: : ...Slightly less than half? Or significantly less than half? Because I do not feel good about those odds if it is the former.
lines.zh: : ……稍微不到一半？还是远远不到一半？如果是前者，我对这个概率可不太放心。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. You’ve already decided and I’m going to be there with you every step of the way.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你已经决定了，而我会一路陪着你。

lines.en: : Unless you or Rin asks me to leave.
lines.zh: : 除非你或者 Rin 让我走。

lines.en: : If that happens, I imagine I’ll put up a fight for a little while but ultimately just go anyway.
lines.zh: : 真到那一步，我想我会挣扎一阵子，但最终还是会走的。

lines.en: scene mollydormchanging23
: Good thing we stopped at that leyline earlier. Otherwise, there is no way I’d allow you to talk me into this.
lines.zh: : 幸好我们刚才在那条灵脉边上停了一下。不然我说什么也不会被您劝动。

lines.en: : Sure you would. You just needed an excuse to do something you already wanted to do, and telling you this is just one more example of my brutal honesty making things better.
lines.zh: : 你会的。你只是需要一个借口去做你本来就想过要做的事，而我跟你这么说，不过是我那残忍的诚实让事情变好的又一个例子。

lines.en: : That didn’t make anything better at all...
lines.zh: : 这可一点都没让事情变好……

lines.en: scene black
Molly decides to keep her pajamas on for the trip back downstairs- probably because it would look weird to get dressed up for a second round of rejection.
lines.zh: Molly 决定穿着睡衣下楼——大概是因为为了第二轮被拒绝而特意打扮一番，看起来也太奇怪了。

lines.en: Or, in the best case scenario- the {i}first{/i} case of her and Rin trying to make things work.
lines.zh: 或者，往最好的情况说——是她和 Rin {i}第一次{/i}试着把事情做成。

lines.en: We just have to hope at this point that Rin is still awake.
lines.zh: 眼下我们只能指望 Rin 还醒着。

lines.en: But given how excited she still seems to have a girlfriend, I imagine it’s possible she hasn’t slept at all since the beach.
lines.zh: 不过看她交到女朋友之后还那么兴奋，我想她有可能从海边回来之后就一直没睡过。

lines.en: But hey, that puts her back into the same category as Molly, even if the two of them have already begun to drift apart.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这也让她和 Molly 归到了同一类里，尽管她们俩已经开始渐行渐远。

lines.en: Maybe this small similarity, albeit the result of opposite extremes, is all they’ll need in order to get closer again.
lines.zh: 也许这个小小的相似之处——尽管源自两个相反的极端——就足以让她们重新靠近。

lines.en: Or maybe it will end things once and for all.
lines.zh: 也可能让一切彻底结束。

lines.en: You can’t ever really know until it’s too late, can you?
lines.zh: 有些事，非到为时已晚，你永远都不会真的知道，不是吗？
